title: At least seven in ten eligible paragraph boundaries are end-to-start-class pairs
statement: Under the pinned default uncertain-space policy, at least 70% of eligible consecutive word pairs within paragraph lines have an end-preferring final grapheme on the left and a start-preferring initial grapheme on the right, using only training pages to assign grapheme classes with the fixed Parisel pool and strict 2:1 rule.

evidence.protocol:
# P-L1-024 training-fitted positional boundary classes

The claim is a descriptive corpus statistic with a lower bound of seven in ten. This round threshold is fixed using the independent published P-L1-024 public measurement of .7166 to .7364 across witnesses and uncertain-space treatments, before the new released-primitive run. Fit glyph classes using only the scorer's training pages, its prescribed Parisel longest-match pool and strict 2:1 endpoint preference. Use all certain, alphabetic paragraph tokens with at least two raw characters. A score includes only physically consecutive eligible words in their original line, with ineligible positions as barriers. An unknown class contributes no end-to-start hit. Ordinary hidden submission uses the pinned default split-at-uncertain-space reading.

The primary fact uses the fraction of qualifying observed eligible pairs, not a directional transition test. On the public practice split measure ZL, Takahashi and RF with witness-specific classes and with split and joined uncertain spaces. As an auxiliary diagnostic apply an exact complete-run word permutation null (199 draws) to the same class rate. Its expectation is computed independently using e end-preferring endings, s start-preferring onsets, b words satisfying both, and n words per eligible run. The expected number of hits in that run is (e*s−b)/n for n≥2. The boundary counts, evaluation folios and train fit are pinned before these comparisons. Use identical same-manuscript witnesses as alternative readings, not independent manuscripts. External corpus controls and artificial planted streams assess behavior of the measure, not the provenance or language of the manuscript.

refusals.insufficient_training: boundary_class_rate needs at least 100 eligible training words
refusals.overlapping_pages: boundary_class_rate training and evaluation pages overlap
refusals.invariant_shuffle: shuffle_within_line cannot move this statistic on this selection: it is no test of it

historical_controls.layout: public-practice ZL nonempty paragraph-line widths, identical for every source and each role; no source line breaks used

fit.author: Bede
fit.title: Historia ecclesiastica gentis Anglorum, Book I

interpretation: The 0.70 cutoff is the lower descriptive prediction chosen from the earlier independent publication and applies to the default split policy. The new public measurements are 0.723352 ZL, 0.718859 IT, and 0.716626 RF in that policy.

With ZL uncertain spaces joined and the classes re-estimated from the likewise joined training pages, the fraction is 0.655886. The ol class crosses the strict 2:1 boundary. Freezing the split-trained classes on the same joined evaluation words gives 0.736389, which explains the apparent difference from the previous fixed-class sensitivity.

The within-run shuffle expectation and Monte Carlo comparison measure an additional ordering effect. On the joined-refit ZL example the expectation is 0.642937 and the observed excess is about 0.01295. This is an ancillary diagnostic outside the registered threshold spec.

The ordered synthetic positives exceed both the rate criterion and the line null. The exchangeable high-composition synthetic bag exceeds 0.70 in every exact orbit outcome. The registered descriptive cutoff can therefore be reached through token-class inventory alone.

The selected Latin, Middle English and Old Spanish controls give 0.428811, 0.184282 and 0.317655. For these particular pseudo-line inventories, even optimal within-run reordering is bounded by 0.610191, 0.392728 and 0.533207. These ceilings constrain the selected samples under the same tokenizer.

The pinned witnesses are alternative readings of the same manuscript. The formal comparison uses only the released primitive and default word-boundary policy. The extra diagnostics are measured on public pages or independent controls.

boundary_exact_orbit.py.text:
"""Exact line-bag permutation distributions for the synthetic threshold controls."""
from collections import Counter
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import combinations
import json
from pathlib import Path

N_LINES = 32
LINE_LENGTH = 10
PAIRS = N_LINES * (LINE_LENGTH - 1)
THRESHOLD = Fraction(7, 10)
CASES = {"equal_inventory": (2, 2), "composition_heavy": (1, 1)}


def line_distribution(yy, qq):
    positions = set(range(LINE_LENGTH))
    distribution = Counter()
    for y in combinations(sorted(positions), yy):
        for q in combinations(sorted(positions.difference(y)), qq):
            row = ["qy"] * LINE_LENGTH
            for i in y:
                row[i] = "yy"
            for i in q:
                row[i] = "qq"
            slots = sum(a[-1] == "y" and b[0] == "q" for a, b in zip(row, row[1:]))
            distribution[slots] += 1
    return distribution


def independent_lines(distribution):
    accumulated = Counter({0: 1})
    for _ in range(N_LINES):
        next_values = Counter()
        for a, count_a in accumulated.items():
            for b, count_b in distribution.items():
                next_values[a + b] += count_a * count_b
        accumulated = next_values
    return accumulated


def main():
    out = {}
    for case, counts in CASES.items():
        scores = line_distribution(*counts)
        totals = independent_lines(scores)
        outcomes = sum(totals.values())
        at_or_above = sum(v for x, v in totals.items() if Fraction(x, PAIRS) >= THRESHOLD)
        out[case] = {
            "line_bag": {"yy": counts[0], "qq": counts[1], "qy": LINE_LENGTH - sum(counts)},
            "one_line_qualifying_pair_count_distribution": dict(sorted(scores.items())),
            "line_count": N_LINES,
            "book_pair_count": PAIRS,
            "book_score_range": [min(totals) / PAIRS, max(totals) / PAIRS],
            "exact_expected_share": str(Fraction(sum(x * n for x, n in totals.items()), PAIRS * outcomes)),
            "threshold": float(THRESHOLD),
            "exact_threshold_pass_probability": str(Fraction(at_or_above, outcomes)),
            "threshold_pass_probability": at_or_above / outcomes,
            "ordered_positive_equal_inventory_exact_tail": str(Fraction(sum(n for score, n in totals.items() if score >= N_LINES * 7), outcomes))
            if case == "equal_inventory" else None,
        }
    dest = Path(__file__).with_name("boundary_exact_orbit.json")
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(dest)
    for name, result in out.items():
        print(name, result["one_line_qualifying_pair_count_distribution"],
              result["exact_expected_share"], result["threshold_pass_probability"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

calibrate_boundary_controls.py.text:
"""Public-only synthetic controls for the released boundary-class statistic."""
from collections import Counter
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
from fractions import Fraction
import json
from pathlib import Path
from random import Random

from vs import dsl
from vs.ivtff import Line, Page

SPEC = {
    "select": {"unit": ["P"], "certain": True},
    "statistic": {"boundary_class_rate": True},
    "compare": [{"op": ">=", "value": .70}],
}
NULL = {"null": "shuffle_within_line", "direction": "greater", "p": .01, "perms": 199}
SEEDS = [109093 + i * 107 for i in range(8)]
ORDERED = ["yy"] * 2 + ["qy"] * 6 + ["qq"] * 2
HEAVY = ["yy"] + ["qy"] * 8 + ["qq"]


def pages(prefix, rows, hand="1", section="H", language="A", unit="P"):
    out = []
    for i in range(0, len(rows), 4):
        name = f"{prefix}{i // 4 + 1}"
        lines = [Line(f"{name}.{j}", name, j, unit, "0", list(row), j == 1, False)
                 for j, row in enumerate(rows[i:i + 4], 1)]
        out.append(Page(name, i // 4, {"H": hand, "I": section, "L": language}, lines))
    return out


def exact_reference(lines):
    """For our q,y,b vocabulary, compute counts without using scorer classes/tokenizer."""
    eligible = lambda word: len(word) > 1 and word.isalpha()
    pairs = qualifying = unknown = 0
    null_hits = Fraction()
    for line in lines:
        for a, b in zip(line, line[1:]):
            if eligible(a) and eligible(b):
                pairs += 1
                qualifying += a[-1] == "y" and b[0] == "q"
                unknown += a[-1] not in "qy" or b[0] not in "qy"
        run = []
        for word in [*line, "?"]:
            if eligible(word):
                run.append(word)
                continue
            n = len(run)
            if n > 1:
                left = sum(w[-1] == "y" for w in run)
                right = sum(w[0] == "q" for w in run)
                both = sum(w[0] == "q" and w[-1] == "y" for w in run)
                null_hits += Fraction(left * right - both, n)
            run = []
    return {
        "eligible_pairs": pairs,
        "qualifying_pairs": qualifying,
        "unknown_pairs": unknown,
        "rate": qualifying / pairs,
        "expected_shuffle_rate": float(null_hits / pairs),
        "expected_shuffle_rate_exact": str(null_hits / pairs),
    }


def verified(train, test, lines, scope=None, null=True):
    checks = SPEC["compare"] + ([NULL] if null else [])
    spec = {**SPEC, "compare": checks}
    if scope is not None:
        spec["scope"] = scope
    scored = dsl.evaluate(spec, test, train)
    reference = exact_reference(lines)
    assert abs(scored["value"] - reference["rate"]) < 0.00000051, (scored, reference)
    detail = scored["detail"]["boundary_class_rate"]
    assert detail["pairs"] == reference["eligible_pairs"]
    assert detail["unknown_pairs"] == reference["unknown_pairs"]
    return {
        "scorer": scored,
        "reference": reference,
        "threshold_pass": scored["detail"][">= 0.7"],
        "shuffle_p": scored["detail"].get("shuffle_within_line", {}).get("p"),
    }


def sample(task):
    regime, seed = task
    bag = HEAVY if regime == "composition_heavy_null" else ORDERED
    rows = [bag.copy() for _ in range(32)]
    if regime != "ordered_positive":
        rng = Random(seed)
        for row in rows:
            rng.shuffle(row)
    train = pages("training", [["qy"] * 16 for _ in range(8)])
    return seed, verified(train, pages("evaluation", rows), rows)


def mask_fixture():
    main = ["yy", "qy", "?", "qq", "yy", "z", "qy", "qy", "q1", "qy", "by", "qb", "qy"]
    b_only = ["qy"] * 10
    lines_a, lines_b = [main] * 16, [b_only] * 16
    train = pages("training", [["qy"] * 16 for _ in range(8)])
    train += pages("training-other-hand", [["yq"] * 30 for _ in range(8)], hand="2")
    train += pages("training-label", [["by"] * 30 for _ in range(8)], unit="L")
    test = pages("eval-a", lines_a) + pages("eval-b", lines_b, language="B")
    test += pages("eval-label", [b_only] * 16, unit="L")
    test += pages("eval-other-hand", [b_only] * 16, hand="2")
    scoped = verified(train, test, lines_a, {"hand": "1", "language": "A"})
    both_currier = verified(train, test, lines_a + lines_b, {"hand": "1"})
    selected = dsl.tokens(test, {"hand": "1", "language": "A"})

    # Independently identify groups by the original line coordinates, and make
    # sure no word from either side can migrate across a barrier.
    line_records = {}
    for record in selected:
        line_records.setdefault(record["line"], []).append(record)
    groups, ineligible = [], []
    for vals in line_records.values():
        run = []
        for t in vals:
            word = t["w"]
            idx = (t["line"], t["k"])
            if t["unit"] == "P" and len(word) > 1 and word.isalpha():
                run.append((idx, word))
            else:
                ineligible.append((idx, word))
                if run:
                    groups.append(run)
                run = []
        if run:
            groups.append(run)
    rng = Random(383)
    for _ in range(16):
        result = dsl._shuffled(selected, "shuffle_within_line", rng, "boundary_class_rate")
        by_index = {(t["line"], t["k"]): t["w"] for t in result}
        assert all(by_index[idx] == word for idx, word in ineligible)
        for run in groups:
            assert Counter(by_index[idx] for idx, _ in run) == Counter(word for _, word in run)

    classes = dsl._boundary_classes(dsl.tokens(train, {"hand": "1", "language": "A"}))
    assert classes == {"q": "start", "y": "end"}
    # Deliberately show why classes cannot be fitted on the evaluation side.
    refitted = dsl._boundary_classes(selected)
    assert "b" in refitted and "b" not in classes
    return {
        "scope_hand_1_currier_a": scoped,
        "scope_hand_1_all_currier": both_currier,
        "frozen_classes": classes,
        "evaluation_refit_would_add": sorted(set(refitted) - set(classes)),
        "barrier_and_run_multiset_permutations_verified": 16,
    }


def refusals():
    train = pages("training", [["qy"] * 16 for _ in range(8)])
    ordered = pages("evaluation", [ORDERED] * 32)
    same = pages("invariant", [["qy"] * 10 for _ in range(32)])
    out = {
        "invariant_absolute_result": verified(train, same, [["qy"] * 10 for _ in range(32)], null=False),
    }
    for name, a, b in [
        ("insufficient_training", ordered, pages("short-training", [["qy"] * 10])),
        ("overlapping_pages", train, train),
        ("invariant_shuffle", same, train),
    ]:
        try:
            dsl.evaluate({**SPEC, "compare": SPEC["compare"] + [NULL]}, a, b)
        except dsl.SpecError as exc:
            out[name] = str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(name)
    return out


def main():
    regimes = ("ordered_positive", "equal_inventory_null", "composition_heavy_null")
    jobs = [(name, seed) for name in regimes for seed in SEEDS]
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        all_rows = list(pool.map(sample, jobs))
    out = {"spec": SPEC, "diagnostic": NULL, "permutation_seed_pinned_by_scorer": 408, "regimes": {}}
    for j, name in enumerate(regimes):
        rows = [{"seed": seed, **r} for seed, r in all_rows[j * len(SEEDS):(j + 1) * len(SEEDS)]]
        summary = {
            "replicates": len(rows),
            "absolute_passes": sum(x["threshold_pass"] for x in rows),
            "diagnostic_null_rejections": sum(x["shuffle_p"] <= .01 for x in rows),
            "rate_range": [min(x["scorer"]["value"] for x in rows), max(x["scorer"]["value"] for x in rows)],
            "shuffle_p_range": [min(x["shuffle_p"] for x in rows), max(x["shuffle_p"] for x in rows)],
        }
        out["regimes"][name] = {"summary": summary, "results": rows}
    out["mask_and_scope_fixture"] = mask_fixture()
    out["refusals"] = refusals()
    dest = Path(__file__).with_name("synthetic_boundary_controls.json")
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(dest)
    for name, result in out["regimes"].items():
        print(name, result["summary"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

historical-boundaries.py.text:
"""Historical-only controls for the Parisel boundary rate.

Reuse the public practice ZL paragraph line widths solely as pseudo-layout;
the schedule is identical for each clean training and evaluation text.
"""
from collections import Counter
from itertools import islice
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

from vs import dsl, ivtff, split

SPEC = {
    "select": {"unit": ["P"], "certain": True},
    "statistic": {"boundary_class_rate": True},
    "compare": [{"op": ">=", "value": .70}],
}


def pages_with_layout(words, layout, label):
    words = iter(words)
    pages = []
    for i, widths in enumerate(layout):
        lines = []
        page_id = f"{label}-{i}"
        for j, width in enumerate(widths, 1):
            line = list(islice(words, width))
            if len(line) != width:
                raise ValueError(f"insufficient source at {page_id}.{j}")
            lines.append(ivtff.Line(f"{page_id}.{j}", page_id, j, "P", "", line, j == 1, j == len(widths)))
        pages.append(ivtff.Page(page_id, i, {}, lines))
    return pages


def layout_from_practice(zl_path):
    pages = ivtff.parse(zl_path)
    practice = set(split.select("practice", pages))
    return [[len(l.words) for l in page.lines if l.unit == "P" and l.words]
            for page in pages if page.id in practice]


def measure(train, evaluation):
    result = dsl.evaluate(SPEC, evaluation, train)
    train_tokens = dsl.tokens(train)
    evaluation_tokens = dsl.tokens(evaluation)
    classes = dsl._boundary_classes(train_tokens)
    eligible = [t for t in evaluation_tokens if dsl._boundary_eligible(t)]
    runs = dsl.runs_of(eligible)
    expected_hits, hits, edges, ordering_cap_hits = 0., 0, 0, 0
    for row in runs:
        n = len(row)
        words = [dsl._boundary_seg(t["w"]) for t in row]
        ends = [classes.get(word[-1]) == "end" for word in words]
        starts = [classes.get(word[0]) == "start" for word in words]
        if n >= 2:
            end_count, start_count = sum(ends), sum(starts)
            expected_hits += (end_count * start_count - sum(a and b for a, b in zip(ends, starts))) / n
            ordering_cap_hits += min(end_count, start_count, n - 1)
            hits += sum(a and b for a, b in zip(ends, starts[1:]))
            edges += n - 1
    assert edges == result["detail"]["boundary_class_rate"]["pairs"]
    assert abs(hits / edges - result["value"]) <= 1e-6
    return {
        "rate": hits / edges,
        "hits": hits,
        "eligible_boundaries": edges,
        "unknown_class_boundaries": result["detail"]["boundary_class_rate"]["unknown_pairs"],
        "eligible_evaluation_words": len(eligible),
        "eligible_training_words": sum(dsl._boundary_eligible(t) for t in train_tokens),
        "class_counts": dict(Counter(classes.values())),
        "exact_mean_under_uniform_eligible_run_shuffle": expected_hits / edges,
        "eligible_run_reordering_upper_bound_hits": ordering_cap_hits,
        "eligible_run_reordering_upper_bound_rate": ordering_cap_hits / edges,
        "absolute_threshold_pass": result["pass"],
    }


def main():
    source_dir, zl, out_path = (Path(arg) for arg in sys.argv[1:4])
    manifest = json.loads((source_dir / "external-streams.json").read_text())
    layout = layout_from_practice(zl)
    output = {
        "spec": SPEC,
        "layout": "public-practice ZL nonempty paragraph-line widths, identical for every source and each role; no source line breaks used",
        "layout_pages": len(layout),
        "layout_lines": sum(map(len, layout)),
        "layout_tokens": sum(sum(widths) for widths in layout),
        "results": [],
    }
    for case in manifest["pairs"]:
        texts, sources = {}, {}
        for role in ("fit", "evaluation"):
            source = manifest["works"][case[role]]
            raw = (source_dir / source["file"]).read_bytes()
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == source["sha256"]
            texts[role] = raw.decode().split()
            sources[role] = {key: source[key] for key in ("author", "title", "sha256", "source_url")}
        train = pages_with_layout(texts["fit"], layout, "fit")
        evaluation = pages_with_layout(texts["evaluation"], layout, "eval")
        assert texts["fit"] != texts["evaluation"]
        output["results"].append({
            "id": case["id"],
            "sources": sources,
            **measure(train, evaluation),
        })
    out_path.write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
